english.title: Obtain pecuniary advantage by deception for another
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) dishonestly obtained for another a pecuniary advantage, namely

(A)_[that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to borrow by way of an overdraft from **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(B)_[that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to take out a policy of insurance with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(C)_[that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to take out an annuity contract with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(D)_[obtained an improvement in the terms on which **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to borrow by way of an overdraft from **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(E)_[obtained an improvement in the terms on which **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to take out a policy of insurance with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(F)_[obtained an improvement in the terms on which **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was allowed to take out an annuity contract with **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_
(G)_[that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was given the opportunity to earn remuneration or greater remuneration in an office or employment,]_
(H)_[that **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) was given the opportunity to win money by betting]_

by deception, namely by falsely representing that **(..SPECIFY DECEPTION..).
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(1) of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
dishonestly obtain for another a pecuniary advantage of
borrowing by way of overdraft OR
taking out policy of insurance OR
taking out an annuity contract OR
obtaining improvement OR
being given an opportunity earn remuneration OR
win money by betting by deception

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
